probe: What leads you from being passed over to wondering if you are "not good enough"?
premise: Missing out on a promotion is a verdict on your personal adequacy.

pairs.reflection: i dont know really. if i work harder than everyone and still dont get it then it has to be something about me right. either im not as good as i think or they just dont notice me. i keep going back and forth between those two
pairs.reply: Stay with that link for a moment. What makes hard work not leading to a promotion mean something about you, rather than something about the promotion?

pairs.reflection: i mean what else would it be. the promotion goes to whoever is best or whoever they notice and its not me so. i dont really know how else to look at it
pairs.reply: We wondered whether underneath this is a sense that missing out on the promotion is a verdict on how adequate you are as a person. Does that fit, or does it miss?

pairs.reflection: kind of i guess. i mean it doesnt feel like a verdict on me as a person just on my work. but my work is most of what i am so maybe thats the same thing. not sure
pairs.reply: When work is most of what you are, what happens to the rest of you when the work isn't chosen?
